title: Siddhartha
author: Hermann Hesse
summary: A young Brahmin in ancient India leaves home to find enlightenment. He tries asceticism, wealth and love before learning something from a quiet ferryman by the river.
readIf: you want a short, calm, reflective book about searching for meaning.
skipIf: you want a lot of plot or are put off by spiritual themes.

pairings.reason: A lighter, more popular story of a young man searching for his purpose.
Another short, gentle book of questions about what really matters.
The author's later, darker book about a man torn between the spiritual and the animal.
